items.text: This week, I spent a Day in the District visiting the @CityofSanMateo. I was able to tour some major project sites including the expansion of the sewer system & wastewater treatment plant, a 100% affordable housing community & the incredible Samaritan House. Watch for more ⬇️ https://t.co/Bkcm3fGMfJ

It’s unacceptable that Filipino WWII vets who served bravely under US command never saw the benefits they were promised. Check out the article below to learn about the history of this disparate & unjust treatment & my bill to restore benefits ⬇️ https://t.co/8VUreibxal
🚨🍂It’s time to fall back and get an extra hour of sleep! Daylight savings time ends this Sunday at 2 AM. Don’t forget to set your clocks back an hour. https://t.co/Adf9iQj2Bh

On #WorldAIDSDay, I'm joining my @EqualityCaucus colleagues to renew our fight to end the global HIV epidemic & reduce stigmas. We must address the disparate impact on communities of color & the LGBTQ+ community by increasing access to preventative medicine, testing & treatment.

Airplane noise is more than just an annoyance: it interrupts sleep, damages hearing & increases the risk of heart attacks. I joined my CA colleagues @RepJimmyPanetta @RepCardenas @RepAnnaEshoo to intro a legislative package that addresses these serious health & safety concerns.
San Francisco & peninsula residents are long overdue for some relief & peaceful sleep. Read more below. https://t.co/2EYNzQGTKP

Trump just fired the HHS team responsible for calculating the Federal Poverty Line, which determines eligibility for programs like Medicaid, food assistance, and child care.

Trump & DOGE are blocking hardworking Americans from getting the basic assistance they deserve. https://t.co/7WhNqGKCFg

A new @EnergyCommerce report shows that Republicans' proposed Medicaid “work requirements” just add red tape and waste taxpayer dollars. 

In my district alone, 111,000 are at risk. Republicans are trying to slash essential health care just so they can give billionaires and corporations tax breaks, this isn’t efficiency, it’s cruelty.

It's Public Service Recognition Week. Trump & DOGE have wreaked havoc on hardworking federal workers who provide essential services for Americans.

This week, let's recognize the value of our federal workforce and protect them from chaotic and immoral treatment. https://t.co/krWESwNtP9

Republicans are trying to strip healthcare and food assistance from kids, parents, seniors, people with disabilities, and veterans.

Proud to join my fellow @HouseDemocrats in saying hands OFF Medicaid and SNAP!
If Republicans do vote to gut Medicaid, I hope they’re prepared to look their constituents in the eye and tell them why they’re stripping health coverage from 13.7 million Americans.

My @EnergyCommerce colleagues and I are pushing back against Republicans' efforts to gut Medicaid and strip health coverage from 13.7 million Americans. 

We're fighting for people like Corey—whose livelihood depends on this essential program. https://t.co/xv2wO9nWUI

It’s been over 20hrs straight and we’re not backing down because Medicaid matters. 

Republicans waited until the dead of night to bring up their plan to kick 13.7M people off health insurance. 

I’m with @EnergyCommerce Democrats standing up to the Republicans’ scam.
I am deeply saddened to hear about President Biden’s cancer diagnosis. My thoughts are with him and his family during this difficult time, and I’m wishing him a full and quick recovery.

LBGTQ+ rights are human rights. It's disturbing to see SCOTUS rolling back protections for  trans youth.

Healthcare decisions should be left up to an individual & their doctors – not politicians sowing division with fear tactics.

Thanks to all who came to my recent town hall, where we talked about many of your concerns including protecting government programs like Head Start and Medicaid.

In case you missed it, you can watch a full recap of the town hall at https://t.co/471YlOHToT https://t.co/woSiM4azay

Under the Republican budget, the nonpartisan CBO estimates that 16 million people will lose their health insurance. 

That includes, kids, parents, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities who rely on Medicaid.

House Democrats are united in protecting your health care and stopping this disastrous budget.

Planned Parenthood provides critical health care, cancer screenings, birth control, STI testing & more to Medicaid patients in CA-15 and nationwide.

I join @ReproCaucus in denouncing SCOTUS's decision and attacks on the right to access quality health care without partisan interference.

Trump's big, ugly bill just got uglier. It strips healthcare and food assistance from millions, guts clean energy tax credits, and adds $4 TRILLION to the U.S. debt. 

All to give tax breaks to billionaires.

I'm heading to DC to vote NO. https://t.co/hJsftKI0tn

My constituent, Corey, is disabled & relies on a group home only made possible by Medicaid reimbursements.

Today, I’ll be thinking of Corey when I vote NO on Trump’s big, ugly bill that strips healthcare from 17 million including children, seniors, & those with disabilities. https://t.co/xUPvSy5Nl6

Trump's big, ugly bill will hurt Californians, gutting Medi-Cal and leaving 2.3 million without the care they rely on.

Medicaid is a lifeline for so many. I'm a firm NO on this big, ugly bill. https://t.co/zgb8tWQKDi

I’m getting ready to head to the House floor and vote NO on Trump’s Big, Ugly Bill after a quick nap in my Capitol Hill office.

@HouseDemocrats are united in fighting back against the largest cuts to Medicaid, SNAP, and other essential programs in American history. https://t.co/2cuvyvCp7N

Republicans just turned their backs on the American people by passing Trump's big, ugly bill. They voted to take away healthcare from 17 million, slash food assistance, & add trillions to the debt.

I voted NO, along with my Democratic colleagues. Read my full statement ⬇️ https://t.co/TKtp3rcTvI
